name: Single-pass vertex-based multi-view PBR
definition: A single-pass implementation that calculates parametric coordinates for all N views in the vertex shader and performs a simple test in the fragment shader to achieve ray-splat intersection.
summary: Single-pass vertex-based multi-view PBR computes ray-splat intersections in the vertex shader to render multiple views in one pass, differing from fragment-based methods by shifting computation to the vertex stage despite performance limitations.
